info.description: Operations wall for Zabbix: inventory health, availability, CPU/memory/disk/network utilisation, data freshness, top servers and active problems. Panels are driven directly by Zabbix host groups, host tags (environment, tier, business_service) and standard agent item keys. Every KPI count, Business Services row and DR Readiness row is click-through to a filterable server inventory scoped to that row, and every host square opens a per-server drawer with gauges, 24-hour history, filesystem usage and that host's problems. Includes a deterministic sample dataset, which can be enabled or disabled on the plugin's Zabbix connection tab; when disabled the dashboard is live-only and hides the SAMPLE switch. The live Zabbix server address, transport and authentication (API token or username/password) are also configured there, so the plugin can be installed on any Grafana server and point at a remote Zabbix. Read the Overview tab for the full panel-to-tag mapping.
